newsitem.title: GERMANY: DASA to keep Dorniers informed on plans.
newsitem.headline: DASA to keep Dorniers informed on plans.

text.p: Reacting to criticism of the way it was handling a cooperation agreement with France's Lagardere, Daimler-Benz Aerospace AG (DASA) said on Friday it would keep one of the key members from the German side of the deal informed of how the talks were proceeding.
A DASA spokesman said it had told Martine Dornier-Tiefenthaler it would inform her of business developments which would affect her faimily's stake in DASA's business.
Dornier-Tiefenthaler lays claim to a say in DASA decisions on satellite and guided missiles through her family's stake in DASA unit Dornier GmbH.

In a newspaper interview earlier this week, Dornier-Tiefenthaler had criticised DASA for not keeping her informed of its plans to sign a strategic cooperation agreement with Lagardere that covers missiles, space and defence electronics.
